title: Novel use of a bronchoscope and bariatric needle holder for retrieval of retained intramedullary metalwork during total knee arthroplasty
author: Oladeji, Masunda, et al.

steps.title: Position the patient
steps.instruction: Place the patient in the supine position with the operating table inclined to 30˚ and the involved leg dropped over the side of the table.

steps.title: Visualize the metalwork
steps.instruction: Carefully guide a sterile single-use video bronchoscope (AmbuR aScopeTM) connected to an HD monitor into the medullary canal to visualize the misplaced metalwork.

substeps.instruction: Utilize the 180-degree arc of tip angulation as needed
Use flush and suction capabilities if required

steps.title: Retrieve the metalwork
steps.instruction: Retrieve the retained pin under direct vision using a bariatric needle holder.

substeps.instruction: Insert the narrow calibre bariatric needle holder into the medullary canal
Manoeuvre the holder to grasp the pin and extract it
